sections.text:
testnet: fix symmetric two-fresh-seeds genesis deadlock (#43) + green the testnet CI lane
Contributed by Ziyang (as exfer-stack) upstream to ahuman-exfer/exfer, the Exfer chain itself.
This pull request is merged.
https://github.com/ahuman-exfer/exfer/pull/44

Two commits, both repairing the testnet that #41 + #42 just merged. Reviewable independently.

### 1. `test: mine valid nonces in reorg_metrics_placement under real testnet PoW`
#41 and #42 each passed CI alone, but merged together they turn main's `test (testnet)` lane red: `tests/reorg_metrics_placement.rs` (from #41) built blocks with `nonce: 0` at `genesis_target()` — valid under the old trivial `0xFF` testnet target, but #42 made the target a real `2^252`, so nonce 0 now fails PoW (`PowFailed`). Fix mines a valid nonce (~16 Argon2id attempts); the corrupted-state_root fork block is re-mined after corruption so it still passes PoW and is `Stored`, preserving the test's intent. Test-only.

### 2. `testnet: fix symmetric two-fresh-seeds genesis deadlock (#43)`
Fixes #43. Two fresh testnet seeds peered only with each other never leave genesis: assume-valid is off, so going `Live` needs a liveness proof none can give (a genesis peer is `confirmed:false`; equal-work tips give no peer-ahead), and the solo bootstrap clause is disqualified the instant they peer (`ever_had_peer` latches).

Extract the eligibility check into `is_bootstrap_eligible` and add a second case: a node still at genesis, peered, no confirmed peer, none ahead, no better-chain claim, past a 90s grace → bootstrap-eligible → goes `Live` and mines block 1; fork choice converges the (at most brief) competing tips. Gated on `cfg!(feature = "testnet")` at the call site, so the **mainnet build is byte-identical** and never hits this topology anyway. Adds a reproducer test and corrects the `main.rs` comment.

## Verification
- Full lib suite green on both lanes; `mainnet_genesis_unchanged` invariant intact; `reorg_metrics_placement` passes under testnet.
- Live: two fresh seeds peered only with each other sit at genesis, then lift off together past the grace and converge on one chain.

(Supersedes #45, which had only commit 1.)
